text_block_list.text:
Today is the first day of summer camp.
We'll be
starting a more rigorous routine
to further
improve performance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I can hear the sound of waves crashing...
The
ocean is so close by.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
To strengthen oneself in the midst of
nature—it
truly evokes the image of
ascetic training. Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Yes, there is much to prepare for the
Kikuka Sho
and, before that, the Kobe
Shimbun Hai.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Now, that's enough idle chitchat. Let's
begin
training right away!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин and I enthusiastically
begin our
summer camp training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
